comment: Read from src/Median at commit 37a37b0, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.2.3, alongside the plugin's wiki page for Median. The wiki says that used polyphonically the outputs take the polyphony of the input with the fewest channels; Median.cpp:116 to 119 take the largest of the three instead, and getPolyVoltageSimd repeats an input's last channel for the rest. The Oversample parameter is declared with no widget (Median.cpp:36), so no click can reach it; it appears on the context menu. The three values are clamped to ±10V after the attenuverter and offset and before they are sorted (Median.cpp:148 to 150).
